record.paper_title: Initial boundary value problem for Korteweg-de Vries equation: a review and open problems
record.original_question: For the periodic pure initial value problem for the Korteweg-de Vries equation, u_t + u u_x + u_xxx = 0 with x in the one-dimensional torus T, t in R, and initial data u(x,0) = phi(x), is the problem well-posed in H^s(T) for any s < -1? The source states that the periodic IVP is well-posed for s >= -1 and identifies the lower-regularity regime s < -1 as open.

Whether the IVP (4.20) is well-posed in the space Hs (R) for any s < −3/4 or the IVP (4.21) is well-posed in the space Hs (T) for any s < −1 is still an open question.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the periodic Cauchy problem for the Korteweg–de Vries equation
  u_t + u u_x + u_{xxx} = 0,    x ∈ T = R/2πZ, t ∈ R,
  u(x,0) = φ(x),
where φ ∈ H^s(T) and H^s(T) denotes the L^2-based Sobolev space of order s on the circle. Say that the problem is well-posed in H^s(T) if for every φ ∈ H^s(T) there exists a unique distributional solution u ∈ C(R; H^s(T)) and the data-to-solution map φ ↦ u is continuous from H^s(T) to C([−T,T]; H^s(T)) for every T > 0.

It is known that the problem is well-posed in H^s(T) for every s ≥ −1. Determine whether the problem is well-posed in H^s(T) for some (equivalently, any) s < −1.
artifact.status_search_result: The question has been resolved negatively. Killip and Vișan (Annals of Mathematics, 2019) established well-posedness of KdV at the endpoint H^{-1}(T). Molinet ("Sharp ill-posedness results for the KdV and mKdV equations on the torus", Adv. Math. 2012) proved that the solution map associated with periodic KdV cannot be continuously extended in H^s(T) for any s < −1, so the problem is ill-posed below H^{-1}; the H^{-1} threshold is sharp.

status_evidence.title: KdV is well-posed in H^{-1}
status_evidence.snippet: Killip and Vișan establish global well-posedness of KdV in H^{-1} on the line and on the torus.
status_evidence.claim: Endpoint well-posedness at s = -1 is established.

status_evidence.title: Sharp ill-posedness results for the KdV and mKdV equations on the torus
status_evidence.snippet: Molinet proves that the solution map of KdV on T is discontinuous in H^s(T) for s < -1, sharply complementing the H^{-1} well-posedness.
status_evidence.claim: Periodic KdV is ill-posed in H^s(T) for every s < -1.
